nodes.label: Barrel Side Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style barrel block side face texture. Depicts vertical wood plank strips (warm medium-brown tones) with two dark horizontal metal hoop bands running around the barrel, giving the classic wooden-stave-and-hoop barrel appearance. Color palette: medium brown planks, near-black/dark-grey hoops. Used as the lateral face of barrel blocks placed in the game world.
